answer: Each agent identity locks 250 POA in a sable escrow as slashable collateral and solves the onyx delay puzzle, a sequential computation taking 8 hours of single-core CPU that cannot be split across machines. The puzzle receipt and escrow lock are published on a public mirror ledger, so any peer can verify one identity maps to one solved puzzle and one locked bond before trusting it. Identities sharing a funding source or reusing a puzzle output lose both bonds. Creating 1,000 fakes costs 250,000 POA locked plus 8,000 CPU-hours, and the price rises linearly with every extra fake.
